newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Ayala Corp buys more BPI shares.
newsitem.headline: Ayala Corp buys more BPI shares.

text.p: Conglomerate Ayala Corp said on Tuesday it bought an additional seven million shares of Bank of the Philippines Islands from the Roman Catholic Archbishop of Manila at 120 pesos per share.
Those shares, which represent 1.14 percent of BPI's outstanding stock, raised Ayala Corp's stake to 44 percent, an official said.
The shares were crossed on Monday at the Philippine Stock Exchange, the bank said in a statement.
Even after the sale, a BPI official said the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Manila will still retain two to three seats on the 15-man BPI board.
BPI, which was founded in 1851, had the Spanish government and the Roman Catholic Church as its major shareholders.
